correctness.rationale: For the canonical conservative radial boundary process, differentiation of \(Y=\rho^4/(16D_0)\) transforms its backward generator exactly to \(y\partial_{yy}+k\partial_y\) with \(k=1-\alpha/2\in[1/2,1]\). This yields \(Y_t=tG_k\) from the reset point; renewal conditioning gives the product of independent exponential age and Gamma shape. Exact gamma product moments yield \(\chi\), and the reset generator \(\mathcal A y=k-ry\) yields the stationary conditional expectation and covariance. The strict digamma integral establishes injectivity; the gamma posterior TP2 argument establishes strict MLR. The seven-file package includes a standalone checker run successfully using symbolic algebra, stationary Bessel-integral quadrature, likelihood-ratio grids, exact BESQ transition sampling and parameter round-trip. No finite test is substituted for universal proof.

value.rationale: The problem of identifying a noise interpretation when diffusivity and reset rate are unknown is directly motivated by published two-dimensional heterogeneous-diffusion inference studies. The discovered exact squared-Bessel coordinate produces two complementary observables: a reset/diffusivity-independent stationary moment ratio strictly identifying the convention and an interpretation/diffusivity-independent stationary fourth-power lag correlation identifying the reset clock. Together with one scale moment they identify all three model parameters, and strict MLR gives a population-wide comparison of radial costs rather than merely an MSD or median comparison. The exact inversion and complete ordering are natural structural information; no claim of finite-sample statistical efficiency or experimental calibration is made.
